cases.exposure_context_quote: His relative reported that he had been found unconscious near their farm, with excessive mouth secretions and profuse sweating. He also noticed a bottle of an insecticide at his side, which might have been taken under the influence of alcohol as the patient is an occasional alcoholic.
cases.agent: Unspecified organophosphate insecticide (bottle found at side; agent name UNVERIFIED)
cases.agent_quote: A 33-year-old farmer was admitted to medicine intensive care unit (ICU) after being brought to casualty in a disoriented state. His relative reported that he had been found unconscious near their farm ... He also noticed a bottle of an insecticide at his side
cases.route: UNVERIFIED (ingestion suspected; bottle found at his side)
cases.circumstance: Found unconscious near the farm with a bottle of insecticide at his side; possibly taken under the influence of alcohol

symptoms.finding: disoriented/unconscious state, excessive mouth secretions, profuse sweating
symptoms.quote: His relative reported that he had been found unconscious near their farm, with excessive mouth secretions and profuse sweating.

symptoms.finding: two to three episodes of greenish vomiting with continuous tremors in hands and legs
symptoms.quote: On their way to the hospital, the patient had two to three episodes of vomiting which was greenish, along with continuous tremors in his hands and legs.

symptoms.finding: GCS 6/15, pinpoint pupils, sluggish deep tendon reflexes (1+), MRC power grade 3 upper limb / 2 lower limb
symptoms.quote: On neurological examination, his Glasgow Coma Scale (GCS) score was 6/15. ... Deep tendon reflexes were found to be sluggish, i.e., 1+ grading. Pinpoint pupils were present. His muscle power on the Medical Research Council (MRC) Scale for Muscle Strength indicated grade 3 in the upper limb and grade 2 in the lower limb, and no sensory symptoms were present.

symptoms.finding: tachypnea (RR 40/min) with arterial oxygen tension <50 mmHg on room air; tachycardia 120 bpm; BP 150/90 mmHg
symptoms.quote: He was intubated immediately with an endotracheal tube with volume control mode as he was presenting with tachypnea (respiratory rate: 40 breaths/min) and arterial blood gases (ABG) showed arterial oxygen tension of less than 50 mmHg on room air.

cases.time_to_care: UNVERIFIED (brought immediately to tertiary care hospital per relatives, exact interval not stated)

labs.name: serum cholinesterase
labs.quote: Laboratory investigations at the time of admission showed normal renal functions, liver functions, and normal serum levels of sodium, potassium, calcium, and magnesium, but serum cholinesterase was 6.7.

labs.name: renal, liver function, electrolytes
labs.quote: Laboratory investigations at the time of admission showed normal renal functions, liver functions, and normal serum levels of sodium, potassium, calcium, and magnesium, but serum cholinesterase was 6.7.

treatment.name: atropine (2 mg loading, infusion 5 mg/hour; later 2 ml/hour infusion)
treatment.quote: medical management was started, which included injection of atropine 2 ml/hour, injection of PAM (Acme Pharmaceuticals, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India) 20 ml/hour, injection of C-Tri (Zuventus Healthcare Ltd, Pune, Maharashtra, India), injection of PAN (Alkem Laboratories Ltd, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India), injection of Emeset (Cipla Ltd, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India), and intravenous fluids.

treatment.name: pralidoxime (PAM) 20 ml/hour
treatment.quote: injection of atropine 2 ml/hour, injection of PAM (Acme Pharmaceuticals, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India) 20 ml/hour

treatment.name: intubation and mechanical ventilation; tracheostomy on day 8
treatment.quote: After eight days, the patient underwent a tracheostomy given prolonged ventilation.

treatment.name: physiotherapy rehabilitation (bronchial hygiene, PNF, mobility exercises, weaning)
treatment.quote: Respiratory therapy interventions included body positioning, bronchial hygiene techniques, chest proprioceptive neuromuscular facilitation (PNF) techniques, and mobility exercises to achieve early ambulation.

cases.icu_admission: Yes ("A 33-year-old farmer was admitted to medicine intensive care unit (ICU) after being brought to casualty in a disoriented state.")
cases.outcome: survived; disconnected from mechanical ventilator in week 4 with spontaneous breathing maintained for 48 hours; progressed to standing and walking; overall functioning improved on scales of consciousness, early mobility and quality of life
cases.outcome_quote: Disconnected from the mechanical ventilator on week 4, the patient was able to maintain spontaneous breathing for 48 hours followed by no further requirement of the ventilator.
cases.sequelae: Prolonged ventilation requirement due to pneumonitis and intermediate syndrome (resolved by week 4); detailed long-term sequelae UNVERIFIED
cases.notes: Diagnosed with organophosphate poisoning (Poisoning Severity Score: minor) associated with intermediate syndrome (IMS).
